name: labs/pymodaq__pymodaq_plugins_basler
title: Basler camera (pymodaq_plugins_basler.hardware.basler:BaslerCamera)
intro: Basler camera (pymodaq_plugins_basler.hardware.basler:BaslerCamera), adapted from pymodaq/pymodaq_plugins_basler. It reads `model_name`, `detector_size`, `exposure_ms`, `gain` and 3 more; sets `roi_x0`, `roi_x1`, `roi_y0`, `roi_y1` and 2 more; runs `start_grabbing`, `stop_grabbing` and `clear_roi`. `start_grabbing`: start continuous acquisition with the camera's current frame rate (the native start_grabbing with None). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
